title: kgdiff layout, version 2
description: One set of coordinates for both versions of a diff (the union layout), as the Rust layout engine (crate kgdiff-layout, `layout_to_json`) writes it: world units, y down. Version 1, written by the TypeScript engine (`layoutToJSON` of @kgdiff/layout), has the same members without `generator`. See https://github.com/iiwish/kgdiff/blob/main/docs/rfcs/0002-rust-compute-core.md#2-contract-boundary

version.description: Readers reject versions they do not support; readers of version 2 also read version 1.

generator.description: The engine generation the positions come from, `kgdiff-layout/<n>`. It changes whenever an algorithm change moves positions for the same input, so that caches can tell layout generations apart; readers treat it as an opaque string.

strategy.description: `union`: the union graph laid out so that neither version is favoured. `anchored`: known positions (pins, or `position` on graph nodes) kept, the other nodes placed around them.

scope.description: `all`: every union node has a position. `changes`: changed nodes, the endpoints of changed edges and some context around them; `hidden` counts the neighbours left out.

iterations.description: Simulation ticks of the largest simulation run (0 when none ran).

positions.description: The position of every node in scope, by union node id, in UTF-16 code unit order of the ids (array-index ids first, as JSON.stringify writes objects). Computed coordinates are rounded to 0.01.

radii.description: The radius of every node in scope, by union node id: nodeRadius of its larger degree across versions, rounded to 0.01.

hidden.description: For scope `changes`: the number of neighbours left out of the layout, for every node in scope that has any. Empty for scope `all`.

bounds.description: The bounds of every node in scope, label boxes included.

components.description: Connected components (over edges and merge / split partners), largest first.

rect.description: An axis-aligned rectangle; the 0.01-aligned hull of what it bounds.

nodes.description: Union node ids, in UTF-16 code unit order.
